name: Atlas 300V Pro Video Analysis Card User Guide - Specifications
notes: PRIMARY VENDOR SOURCE. Same 310-series NPU as Atlas 300I Pro but 48 GB instead of 24 GB, identical 384-bit 4266 Mbit/s LPDDR4X and identical 204.8 GB/s total bandwidth, identical 72 W. The memory-capacity-without-bandwidth pattern is the whole story of this part.
